items.hook: Fishapod fossil shows early elbows came in a variety of forms

items.hook: Sapphira and the Slave Girl is Willa Cather's last novel, published in 1940.
items.body: It is the story of Sapphira Dodderidge Colbert, a bitter white woman, who becomes irrationally jealous of Nancy, a beautiful young slave. The world is stranger than it lets on.
